description: This file implements a tracing system for a browser automation framework, including starting/stopping trace recording, handling trace events, managing resources, and integrating with browser context and page events.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class responsible for managing trace recording, event capturing, resource management, and integration with browser context and page events within a browser automation framework.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes tracing with specified options, setting up directories, state, and starting necessary tracers.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk, setting up event listeners and trace files.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new trace group with a specified name and location.

methods.name: groupEnd
methods.description: Ends the current trace group.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracing and finalizes trace files.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally archiving or discarding it.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all pending trace data and resources.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing tracing activities.

methods.name: deleteTmpTracesDir
methods.description: Deletes temporary traces directory if used.

methods.name: _captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a given SDK object if conditions are met.

methods.name: _shouldCaptureSnapshot
methods.description: Determines whether a snapshot should be captured for a given SDK object and metadata.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles pre-call instrumentation, creating trace events and possibly capturing snapshots.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles pre-input action instrumentation, creating trace events and possibly capturing snapshots.

methods.name: onCallLog
methods.description: Logs API call information into the trace.

methods.name: onAfterCall
methods.description: Handles post-call instrumentation, creating trace events and possibly capturing snapshots.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Marks a HAR entry as started.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Marks a HAR entry as finished and appends it to the trace.

methods.name: flushHarEntries
methods.description: Flushes all pending HAR entries into the trace.

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Handles content blob resource data.

methods.name: onSnapshotterBlob
methods.description: Handles snapshotter blob resource data.

methods.name: onFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Handles frame snapshot data.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Records console messages into the trace.

methods.name: onDialog
methods.description: Records dialog events.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Records download events.

methods.name: onPageOpen
methods.description: Records page open events.

methods.name: onPageClose
methods.description: Records page close events.

methods.name: _onPageError
methods.description: Records page error events.

methods.name: _startScreencastInPage
methods.description: Starts screencast recording in a page.

methods.name: _appendTraceEvent
methods.description: Appends a trace event to the trace file.

methods.name: _appendResource
methods.description: Stores resource data associated with a SHA1 hash.
